          "text": "# Eagle Nebula: A stellar nursery under summer\u2019s wing\n\n*In Serpens, a young star cluster lights a vast cloud of gas and dust. A dark-sky evening\u2014and a little patience\u2014can bring this celebrated deep-sky target within reach.*\n\nThe Eagle Nebula is not a bird in flight, but a region of gas and dust whose dark shapes can suggest wings and talons. Catalogued as Messier 16, it lies in Serpens, near the rich star fields of Sagittarius. At its heart is the young open cluster NGC 6611: the bright stars are easy to recognize in photographs, while the glowing nebula around them asks more of the observer.\n\nThat glow has a physical source.
